boundaries.route: complete current compiler source graph -> independent AOT host ABI -> emitter for target ABI; interpreted igsc retained as a diagnostic
boundaries.invariant: Compile all compiler modules together, not a partial backend overlay. Host native ABI and emitted target ABI are distinct; host runtime is never linked into target. Source/SDK/argv and dependency assumptions remain explicit.
boundaries.benefit: Break old-C/new-header bootstrap cycle and remove interpreted compiler execution from each target emission without restoring carrier aliases or importing repair runtime
boundaries.cost: One whole host compiler AOT build and host SDK storage; no automatic cache-reuse claim without complete source/effect dependency closure

boundaries.route: process.scm command-line/script-command-line -> igsc canonical processed argv -> main.scm command-args
boundaries.invariant: Strip Make runtime aliases from effective script argv, clear the obsolete script view, and preserve all compiler argument words
boundaries.benefit: Eliminate two inconsistent option views; real Make prelude/warnings/source arguments produce C instead of zero-output returns
boundaries.cost: One normalization per invocation; no general shell string decoder or global FFI rewrite claim

boundaries.route: leased source-state inputs -> all top-level lib/gsi/gsc _*.c -> bootclean -> complete generated hash inventory
boundaries.invariant: Required module and linker C units are known before deletion; failed emission cannot shrink the required set to zero
boundaries.benefit: Old module metadata cannot silently survive a changed FrameSpec/ModuleSpec/runtime ABI
boundaries.cost: All affected C products must be regenerated; correctness work is added, not an incremental-build speedup

boundaries.route: same Bazel configure profile -> generated C -> target libgambit/gsi/gsc
boundaries.invariant: Existing O1 modules/O3 runtime and SMP/multiple-VM/threaded-VM flags; exact effective argv/headers recorded; artifact success and quiescence required
boundaries.benefit: One explicit target cohort replaces accidental reuse of old generated carrier accesses
boundaries.cost: No old C shortcut across incompatible layout; canonical compiler/root/lifetime consumers still need native acceptance

boundaries.route: GC_SAVE/RESTORE1..3 and os_setup six service families -> execution_context.saved -> mark_execution_roots -> reload/clear
boundaries.invariant: All raw temporary-root consumers migrate with their scanner. 78 os_setup accesses retain existing conversion/result/error clearing behavior. No carrier alias is restored; fixed three-slot capacity is not arbitrary nested-FFI admission.
boundaries.benefit: Source-complete execution-root ownership covers generated allocation helpers and OS service constructors instead of only six previously compiled C units
boundaries.cost: Existing context indirection at each access; no additional root slots or root-scan range; native GC/FFI progress remains to qualify

boundaries.route: new target gsc -> fresh bootclean -> target self-source pass -> hash/identity receipt
boundaries.invariant: hostedSource and regeneration checkpoints are distinct; a host pass cannot suppress the real self pass
boundaries.benefit: Compiler/runtime agreement is checked through an actual target compiler invocation
boundaries.cost: Second source generation/compilation pass; no model or first-pass result substitutes for it

boundaries.route: new target gsc -exe -> tests/frame-continuation-roots.scm -> real map capture, two restores, GC and native call
boundaries.invariant: Original, 20 and 200 restored map results; 80 retained roots; expected wind/visit history; 11 completed forced GCs; native call count 3
boundaries.benefit: Exercise Gambit multi-shot semantics together with frame/GC/native consumers
boundaries.cost: Independent carrier retirement, all FFI callbacks and failed membership remain separate open gates

Effective script/process compiler argv and a real generated C output; no exit-zero-only success
All 51 generated products and three linked target artifacts with stable source and quiescent successful first pass; not complete self bootstrap or GC semantics
All three scratch-root macro families reload collector-updated roots, clear them and isolate contexts; old macro compilation fails; projection only, not linked GC

Two abstract coverage classes require universal coverage of all 51 native filenames, including 5 linker products; argv agreement, self-pass distinction and no host linkage; finite safety is not native success

Universal per-class coverage reflects complete filename coverage only under total required-name mapping. One representative per class is insufficient. Actual source manifest/compilation correctness remains a native refinement obligation.
OPEN: prove actual generated FrameSpec/root consumers and C barriers preserve the existing conditional root laws; host compiler semantic trust stays explicit

Actual source and self passes plus real semantic case required. Complete official bootstrap additionally needs two occurrences of each phase1..4. Known pre-generated/uncanonical argv failures and interpreted timeout remain retained.
